summary: Chiron Real Estate Inc. (the registrant) filed an 8-K reporting its acquisition of The Landing Alexandria, a senior housing community in Alexandria, VA, for $130 million, closed June 1, 2026. The purchase was funded with a combination of proceeds from a $100M Series C Preferred Stock issuance (1M units at $100 each) and existing cash. The board recommended the transaction; no advisor was named. The preferred units are convertible, with terms similar to the Series C Preferred Stock. The filing also notes a prior purchase contract with Silverstone Senior Living. Watch for integration execution and any shareholder reaction to the funding structure.
